dataset_identity.dataset_name: Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) Bearing Data Center
dataset_identity.institutional_host: Case School of Engineering, Case Western Reserve University
dataset_identity.access_method: Direct full-page HTML inspection of official subpages (apparatus-and-procedures, download-data-file, normal-baseline-data, 12k-drive-end-bearing-fault-data)

licensing_status.terms_summary: The official CWRU pages publish direct download links under university copyright, but provide no formal open license text, terms-of-use agreement, or explicit redistribution grant. Public web download availability does not constitute an affirmative license grant.
licensing_status.legal_conclusion_disclaimer: This document records stated terms factually and does not provide legal advice or a binding legal conclusion.

split_group_policy.limitation_statement: Physical specimen identity across load runs is not established by primary documentation. Precautionary grouping keeps 97/98 and 105/106 together in candidate partitions. Any evaluation is strictly descriptive of same-rig load variation; claims of independent bearing or machine generalization are blocked.

duplicate_and_overlap_detection_rules.description: Deterministic SHA-256 computed strictly across IEEE 754 binary64 float bytes of the raw sample array, independent of file names, containers, or variable naming.
Block-level sample hashing to detect temporal offsets, truncations, or sub-recording overlaps.
Normalized cross-correlation heuristic. Any pair exceeding 0.95 without documented physical distinction is treated as an unresolved suspected duplicate and locked into the same partition.

blocked_analysis_gates.documented_facts: CWRU primary documentation omits accelerometer transducer sensitivity (mV/g), sensor gain settings, and physical output units. Stored values in distributed MAT arrays cannot be assumed to be physical acceleration. File inspection alone cannot guarantee units without explicit documentation; never infer units from signal amplitude or observed maxima.
blocked_analysis_gates.prohibited_action: Do NOT invent conversion factors. No supervisor policy can convert uncalibrated numbers into physical acceleration.

blocked_analysis_gates.documented_facts: CWRU primary documentation omits hardware DAQ voltage input ranges and sensor clipping thresholds. Nominal sensor specifications from third-party literature do not establish acquisition chain limits. File inspection alone cannot establish clipping bounds without explicit documentation; never infer full scale from observed maxima.
blocked_analysis_gates.prohibited_action: Do NOT infer full scale from observed sample maxima or assume nominal sensor limits.

blocked_analysis_gates.documented_facts: Native sampling rates per channel are unconfirmed in primary documentation for normal baseline and individual fault channels. Selecting Drive End alone does not resolve cross-record rate compatibility between normal and fault recordings. File inspection alone cannot guarantee rates without explicit metadata; never infer rates from sample counts alone.
blocked_analysis_gates.prohibited_action: Do NOT execute cross-record comparisons or assume uniform rates until rates are directly verified from explicit documentation. Defer window duration, common-rate choice, and resampling design; no executable recipe is ready.

blocked_analysis_gates.documented_facts: Primary documentation does not establish distinct physical bearing specimens across load tests. All data originated from a single test stand.

resolution_options: Install scipy via uv in an authorized future stage
Implement a minimal zero-dependency pure-Python binary MAT v4/v5 reader

provenance_isolation_policy.synthetic_evaluator_isolation: Strictly preserved; adi-portfolio evaluate retains requirement provenance == 'synthetic' and must not be weakened to accept real data. Real dataset evaluation will be hosted in a separate future evaluation command.
